title: Resume Claims and Evidence
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting resume claims and evidence to resume before-after revision with truthful evidence, role fit, and AI-use note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Convert a duty-list resume bullet into an accomplishment using the action + scope + result pattern, backed by a verifiable fact.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Diagnose which failure mode a weak bullet has (vague, inflated, or borrowed) and apply the matching fix without inventing facts.
